scope: All four original-paper Laurent expansions through epsilon^0. Acceptance is true only with exit0, all four complete ordered outputs, their 20-digit/refinement metadata, and reference/stability/hash checks.

input.epsilon_grid_derivation: Pinned fit_samples_refined and epsilon_samples: count=27+4*attempt; denominator parameter=100*2^attempt; exact epsilon_j=j/(count*denominator parameter).
input.grid_observation_note: Sample events record starts. Advancing to a larger grid can follow an internally retried Accuracy/Numerical failure; only final samples/validation_samples/refinements identify the successful compared fits.

configuration.refinement_schedule_note: Full fitting uses working digits 60, 80, 100, 120 and outer orders 80, 96, 112, 128. The earlier one-sample prerequisite used orders 80 and 112; it is a separate validation.

reference.precision_semantics: Mathematica component decimal precision; null denotes exact zero

reference_check_semantics: Each component uses five units at its recorded Mathematica decimal precision; exact-zero components use absolute tolerance 1e-20. Printed mantissa length is not treated as precision.
precision_semantics: verified_digits follows independent epsilon-grid/working-precision/series-order refinement. Relative 20-digit stability applies to resolved nonzero complex coefficients; absolute 20-digit stability applies near numerical zero. Comparison errors are observed fit changes, not rigorous bounds.

manifest.purpose: Prepare exact differential systems for the second epsilon grid while the first numerical grid runs.
notes: Only exact PreparedFlow systems and native reduction equations are cached.
The acceptance binary still computes the full independent numerical sample grid at increased precision/order and runs the upstream coefficient validator.
The full elapsed time includes assistance from four additional preparation workers and is not a cold four-worker performance measurement.
An exact existing prepared-system cache hit with reductions forbidden verified the helper library/options/cache identity.

helper_provenance_snapshot.purpose: Precompute exact PreparedFlow systems only for the independent second epsilon grid. No numerical boundary/ODE evaluations and no fixture values. Main acceptance performs all numerical evaluations and comparisons.
helper_provenance_snapshot.shared_cache_note: Same cache as the active main acceptance, with epsilon-specific exact identities and atomic writes. Grid i/6200 is disjoint from first grid i/2700.
helper_provenance_snapshot.compile_command: CARGO_CRATE_NAME=refinement_preparer taskset -c 29 rustc --edition=2024 -C opt-level=2 target/prepare-refinement-grid/prepare.rs -L dependency=target/release/deps --extern symbolica_amflow=target/validated-family-bank/libsymbolica_amflow-a085b8c13b0f6efe.rlib --extern symbolica=target/release/deps/libsymbolica-36b8a05356ca23f4.rlib --extern serde_json=target/release/deps/libserde_json-c589b03db684a851.rlib -o target/prepare-refinement-grid/prepare

overlap_summary.method: A separate read-only watcher polled the main Sample events and helper event manifest every 3 seconds. These are observed preparation statuses, not assertions that main had begun numerical ODE evaluation. Pending samples later called the same validated completed-cache read before preparing. Any simultaneous reductions used the existing atomic exact cache protocol. Main event elapsed times are copied verbatim from its events.jsonl.
overlap_summary.timing_scope: Additional exact preparation ran on up to four CPUs 30–33 concurrently with main CPUs 24–27. Warm and overlapping reductions occurred; these durations are not cold four-worker acceptance timing.

extra_exact_preparation.snapshot_note: The helper finished before final report generation. This report preserves its final complete JSON provenance and hash.

timing.caveat: The initial cache contains exact preparation from the earlier epsilon 1/2700 sample. Four additional workers prepare exact second-grid systems concurrently; numerical values and reference data are not supplied. Reported elapsed time is not a cold four-worker performance measurement. started_utc precedes executable hashing; subprocess elapsed time starts afterward.
